overloadMerges.note: property's four documented constants (from the QR Document Properties theme) are recorded as sentinelValues; the parameter table's terse description ('1 = Print Dialog, 2 = Document unit') omits the field/record separator constants that the prose documents.

sentinelValues.meaning: qr printing dialog - display of the print dialog box (0=not displayed, 1=displayed, default)
qr field separator - character code of the field separator (default: FldDelimit, Tab)
qr record separator - character code of the record separator (default: RecDelimit, Carriage Return)

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Retrieves the current value of a Quick Report document-level property (print dialog display, document unit, or field/record separator character code) for area.
